text:
Leah: hi all, first week question — i can connect to bastion but my CI runner on my laptop can't pull artifacts from artifactory.internal:8081 after i connect to corp-vpn. `curl` times out locally but works from bastion. anyone seen this for new hires?
Mark: welcome Leah! quick sanity check: can you paste the `ip route` / `netstat -rn` output while connected to the VPN? also which OS and VPN client?
Leah: macOS Ventura, corp-vpn (WireGuard wrapper). netstat shows only default via home router, no 10.40.0.0/16 or 10.42.0.0/16 routes.
Devon: sounds like the split-tunnel profile for onboarding isn't pushing the artifact VPC routes or internal DNS. we recently tightened onboarding profile to reduce blast radius.
Leah: is there a quick fix? my local runner needs to fetch the image during test runs.
Mark: short-term workaround: tunnel the artifact port through the bastion. `ssh -L 8082:artifactory.internal:8081 ubuntu@bastion.company` then point your CI runner config to `http://localhost:8082`.
Leah: ok trying: `ssh -L 8082:artifactory.internal:8081 leah@bastion.company -N` — running it in background now. curl to localhost:8082 returns the HTML index. that unblocks the runner. thanks.
Devon: i'll open a ticket to include artifactory.internal and the 10.40/10.42 VPC CIDRs in the onboarding split-tunnel profile. note: SecOps must sign off on exposing internal DNS and artifact endpoints to remote endpoints.
Leah: makes sense. do you need my laptop model/serial or MDM status? i'm on a personal laptop but enrolled in MDM.
Mark: please add MDM enrollment proof and laptop model to the ticket — that speeds review. also if security prefers not to expose resolver, we can instead enable an authenticated bastion-side proxy for the CI runner to use. we'll propose both.
Leah: infra-bot, please create the ticket.
infra-bot: Created INFRA-6178: "onboarding: include artifactory.internal + 10.40.0.0/16,10.42.0.0/16 in WireGuard profile; SecOps review" assigned to @Devon. SLA: 72h.
Devon: i put the ticket in the onboarding queue and requested SecOps review. will update here when we get a decision.
Leah: thanks everyone — port-forward got my runner green for now. appreciate the quick help and the welcome :tada:
Mark: welcome aboard! if INFRA-6178 stalls, ping here and we'll escalate.
Leah: will do :)
